title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.26491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems,

translated_title: FLUID：灵活的、有证据支撑的情境化任务指导
translated_abstract: 实时任务指导本质上是灵活的：当智能体引导用户完成任务时，多种回应内容和时机都可能是合适的，有时最好的行动甚至是保持沉默。现有基准测试往往忽视了这种灵活性，将合成的对话视为“说什么”和“何时说”的固定目标。我们提出了FLUID（灵活的、有证据支撑的情境化任务指导），这是一个用于建模、评估和实现多模态任务指导中灵活交互的统一框架。利用来自WTaG和HoloAssist的自然发生的人际指导数据，FLUID将干预行为与其支撑证据、必要性和时机灵活性相绑定，并利用这种表示方法既评估灵活指导的质量，又构建实时任务指导智能体。在所评估的系统中，我们的智能体在回应正确性、干预精确性、指导及时性和响应延迟方面实现了最强的整体平衡。
tldr: FLUID提出一个统一框架，将任务指导干预与证据、必要性和时机灵活性相绑定，用于评估多模态实时任务指导中的灵活交互并构建智能体，该智能体在正确性、精确性、及时性和延迟之间取得了最佳整体平衡。
en_tdlr: FLUID introduces a unified framework that grounds task guidance interventions in evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, enabling both evaluation of flexible interaction in multimodal real-time task guidance and construction of an agent achieving the best overall balance of correctness, precision, timeliness, and latency.
